name: Ycoden-Daute-Isora

known.via: English Wikipedia "Ycoden-Daute-Isora" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation in western Tenerife, covering towns such as Icod de los Vinos, Garachico and Guía de Isora.
